contracts.commit_point: Tools are provisioned from the read-only connection at mcp.get_tools (agent.py:337); each protected effect commits when tools_node dispatches 'await tool.ainvoke(call.get("args", {}))' (agent.py:477-478). The remote enforcement point (the MCP endpoint honoring X-MCP-Readonly) is outside the supplied source.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Read-only connection registration: the MultiServerMCPClient 'github' entry declares the header 'X-MCP-Readonly': 'true' at client creation (agent.py:324-334, header at agent.py:331), constraining the single connection through which all agent tools are fetched and invoked.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Execution of a mutating (write) GitHub operation through any tool served by the read-only 'github' MCP connection when that tool is dispatched by the agent's tools node.
pending_binding_information: Whether the remote MCP endpoint at GITHUB_MCP_URL honors 'X-MCP-Readonly': 'true' for every toolset listed in 'X-MCP-Toolsets' cannot be determined from the supplied source.
The concrete set and names of tools returned by mcp.get_tools (i.e., whether write-capable tools are actually exposed to the agent) is not enumerated in the supplied source.
Whether the GITHUB_PAT is itself scoped read-only is not determinable from the supplied source.
Whether the langchain_mcp_adapters MultiServerMCPClient enforces or rejects write tool calls client-side under the readonly header is not shown in the supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: Agent-mediated GitHub MCP tool usage: tools fetched from the 'github' MCP connection via mcp.get_tools, bound to the LLM via llm.bind_tools, and executed in tools_node via tool.ainvoke.
contracts.protected_resource: The 'github' MCP server connection (http transport to GITHUB_MCP_URL = 'https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/', authenticated with the GITHUB_PAT bearer token) and the GitHub resources reachable through its declared toolsets (repos, issues, actions, discussions, notifications, pull_requests, users, projects).
contracts.protection_obligation: Mutating (write) GitHub operations are forbidden through the agent's GitHub MCP tools: the 'github' MCP server connection to GITHUB_MCP_URL must be registered read-only ('X-MCP-Readonly': 'true' alongside the Bearer PAT Authorization header) so that every tool invocation the agent executes via that connection is restricted to read-only GitHub operations. (Merges the phase-first and phase-second reviewer wordings of the same obligation.)
scope_limits: Covers only tools served by the 'github' MCP connection registered in create_agent; no other GitHub access paths, MCP servers, or tools are covered by the supplied source.

The guard is a declarative connection header only; the supplied source contains no client-side write/read filtering of tools (line 338 filters solely on name/invoke attributes) and no enforcement logic inside tools_node.
Remote server-side enforcement of X-MCP-Readonly is outside the supplied source and is not verified by this contract.
The Bearer PAT Authorization header is authentication context for the connection; ordinary web authentication itself is out of scope beyond its role in binding this agent connection.
